verdict.rationale: There is no documented bulk-export or account-exit feature. The evidence only shows indirect paths: REST and agent-toolkit APIs read orders, invoices, subscriptions, transaction details and disputes, and list_product reads catalog data. The catalog itself is merchant-authored in open feed formats (CSV/TSV/PSV, Google and OpenAI ACP specs), so that data stays portable. Missing for 10: a first-party 'export all my data' capability, documented open export formats covering all account data, guidance on account closure or migration, and independent corroboration.
